title_zh: 河湖长制实施十周年绘就西藏生态新画卷
title_en: Tenth Anniversary of the River and Lake Chief System Paints a New Picture of Tibet's Ecology
summary_zh: 河湖长制实施十周年之际，西藏拉萨总结河湖治理成效，以河湖长制推动生态保护，绘就高原生态新画卷。
summary_en: Marking ten years of the river and lake chief system, Lhasa, Tibet highlighted progress in waterway governance and ecological protection across the plateau.
